scope: Planned evaluation framework for the approved operational capability, governed-write, product-value, and packaging experiments
evidenceGates: A: evidence-bound read and relationship understanding
B: recommendation, draft, proposal, and human disposition
C: bounded reversible write under an explicit time-bounded WriteGrant
D: coordinated cross-functional workflow with verified outcomes
E: bounded active management only after prior gates and a separately accepted authority scope
method: Freeze each protocol, baseline, cases, source/authority boundaries, versions, measures, stop rules, and evidence window before execution.
Separate specification acceptance, implementation status, technical conformance, human usefulness, customer outcomes, safety, economics, and generalizability.
Evaluate grant expiry, revocation, scope, budgets, idempotency, verification, readable receipts, compensation, and uncertain execution for every write-capable experiment.
Require a fresh exact human DeletionAuthorization for every immutable deletion target list; never treat a WriteGrant as deletion authority.
Record negative, failed, adverse, and inconclusive outcomes; a fluent output, schema fixture, or automated pass cannot validate a product-value hypothesis.
commonMeasures: provenance, correction, uncertainty, and source quality
privacy, consent, contact, fairness, surveillance, and customer-harm safety
time, human effort, model/tool/action cost, failure, reversal, and incident cost
claimBoundary: EVAL-004 is a defined plan, not an implemented evaluator and not evidence that EXP-013 through EXP-025 have run. IMP-011 is schema/projection scaffolding only. CAP-001 and EXP-001 remain read-only.
